inputs.plan_text: Required rich plan text with 10+ non-empty lines unless plan_file is provided.
inputs.plan_file: Optional path to a detailed plan file when inline plan_text is not provided.
inputs.requested_business_outcome: Required when caller intent clearly targets business execution outputs. This outcome is the primary completion contract and cannot be replaced by AO runtime artifacts.
inputs.channel: Derived package channel for the execution pass. Infer released versus beta from the current CI/CD-managed skill package version block when package-channel runtime acquisition is used.
inputs.runtime_source_mode: Optional runtime source selection: package-channel by default, or explicit repo-src-debug when debugging this skill inside the current repository and intentionally using current source output.
inputs.workspace_root: Optional existing workspace directory outside the target skill root. When supplied, verified Mermaid and HTML artifacts are mirrored below the workspace for clickable links.

default_assumptions.package_index_source: The source of truth for acquiring the AO package is the absolute URL of the released or beta package index page that matches the current CI/CD-managed skill package version block; the runtime guide and docs bundle are English-only.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_restore: When AO execution needs local package acquisition, resolve the runtime mode first. In self-contained mode, validate and acquire only the exact-RID `Techne.Loom.AgentOrchestrator.Runtime.<rid>` package; in explicit .NET CLI mode, acquire the exact-version .NET runtime bundle (a NuGet restore set that includes the embedded Roslyn compiler assemblies). Never acquire or validate the .NET runtime bundle on the self-contained path.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_layout: Resolve one exact AO version and the runtime mode before package lookup. Self-contained mode uses one exact-RID runtime package and its direct executable; .NET CLI mode uses one exact-version .NET runtime bundle in an external unified directory. Keep the paths independent and do not cross-fallback.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_fallback: If acquisition fails, retry only the same selected artifact path: the same exact-RID package for self-contained mode or the same exact-version .NET runtime bundle for .NET CLI mode. Never switch runtime modes as a fallback.
default_assumptions.runtime_startup_contract: When package-channel .NET CLI mode is used, ao.dll, ao.deps.json, and ao.runtimeconfig.json are mandatory startup-contract files. Missing any of them is runtime-invalid and execution must fail fast before AO command dispatch.
default_assumptions.runtime_preflight_gate: When package-channel runtime execution is used, verify the selected mode: self-contained validates exact-RID package identity/manifest/entrypoint/SHA-512; .NET CLI mode validates startup-contract files plus dependency-closure readiness (including System.Text.Json and Microsoft.Extensions.*) from the same unified runtime before any AO command. If extraction, file checks, or closure checks fail, stop immediately and keep runtime_preflight_result in a failed state.
default_assumptions.package_channel_launch_mode: In package-channel mode, default to the exact-RID self-contained single-file launch (ao.exe/ao) for the detected RID; .NET CLI mode remains explicit through dotnet exec --depsfile <ao.deps.json> --runtimeconfig <ao.runtimeconfig.json> <ao.dll> ... only when runtimeBinding or an explicit bundle directory selects it.
default_assumptions.powershell_5_1_http_probe_rule: When Windows PowerShell 5.1 uses Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod for package-channel HTTP probes, add -UseBasicParsing so runtime acquisition does not stall on legacy browser-engine security prompts.
default_assumptions.runtime_closure_materialization: Build package-channel unified runtime from deterministic NuGet restore/publish closure materialization. Do not treat hand-merged .NET CLI lib trees as sufficient closure evidence.
default_assumptions.business_outcome_first_rule: When objective text or plan files clearly request business outputs, lock execution mode to business-first. AO run/resume are execution machinery only and AO artifact completion cannot replace requested business deliverables.
default_assumptions.meta_only_gate: Do not switch to meta-only execution unless the user explicitly requests runtime verification, contract diagnostics, or AO execution-surface validation.
default_assumptions.think_out_loud_contract: Once the package runtime is prepared, after every dotnet ao.dll CLI call, and again on every AO progress update, think-out-loud must explicitly report resolved_runtime_version, runtime_bundle_packages, and unified_runtime_directory. After every dotnet ao.dll CLI call it must also explicitly report fresh audit_markdown_file and audit_html_file as direct clickable Markdown file links when the call emitted them, or repeat the latest clickable links plus a concise workflow-location summary when the render is unchanged. If the chat agent provides a Mermaid card display tool, pass the existing audit_markdown_file path directly to that tool and do not read or return its contents again solely for display; otherwise use the direct clickable link fallback.
default_assumptions.plain_language_feedback_contract: All user-facing progress, blocked, error, and completion updates from AO, SO, and every enhanced target skill must use the user's requested language and be understandable to a reader with no workflow background at about a high-school reading level. English is not automatically plain language. Use short sentences and common words; state what happened, whether the user's work or data is still safe, why it happened, and the next action. Translate internal status values, step kinds, node IDs, gate/handoff terms, runtime details, and audit jargon into ordinary language. Keep exact commands, paths, IDs, status values, and evidence fields in a separate technical-details section only when needed. Use the Plain-Language Term Examples section in SKILL.md as the model, and include a compact term-conversion table plus before/after examples when creating target-skill feedback.
default_assumptions.must_show_to_user_files_rule: After every dotnet ao.dll, self-contained ao.exe, or ao CLI call, populate must_show_to_user_files with the ordered audit paths that actually exist. This list is for audit continuity and is not a link guarantee. Use mermaid_delivery status, link_resolvable, and workspace-relative paths for user-facing links; use the actual Mermaid path with a card tool when available, otherwise use verified direct clickable links. When no fresh render exists, repeat only the latest verified card or link and state that the render is unchanged; on delivery_failed, report the failure without a guessed path.
default_assumptions.workflow_location_summary: Concise user-facing summary of where the active AO workflow currently is after the current CLI call: current stage, frontier/block/completed status, and whether the Mermaid render changed.
default_assumptions.file_input_preparation_contract: All file input parameters are path-only. The caller must create, finish, and close every required input file before one CLI call; the CLI preflights the complete set before reading, executing, modifying, or writing. Inline script, JSON, patch, and replacement content is rejected. Output paths are destinations owned by the CLI.
default_assumptions.workflow_file_language: Workflow definition files are the canonical English information carrier across AO, SO, and Loom-governanced target skills. Keep workflow-owned schema keys, node and transition names/descriptions, workflow phases, expressions, hints, failure guidance, evidence references, and control metadata in English. Keep user/business payload values and localized user-facing output in their source or requested language; localization belongs in the presentation layer and must not change workflow keys or control semantics.
default_assumptions.repo_src_debug_override: When the caller explicitly requests repo-src-debug while working inside this repository, build and use the current repo AO project output from src/dotnet/Techne.Loom.AgentOrchestrator only to prove local runtime behavior and capture a fresh guide during repository debugging. Once that guide result exists, official governed execution must return to the corresponding published AO package runtime surface rather than continuing official skill execution on repo-src-debug outputs.
default_assumptions.official_execution_completion_gate: For every full-delivery execution of loom-plan-execution itself, dotnet ao.dll compile is validation only and cannot terminate the workflow. After guide handoff and compile validation, create or reuse one fresh external runtime workflow instance copy and record its immutable instance identity, workflow-file path, and persisted runtime-state/session path. Execute dotnet ao.dll run against that exact instance; when the official runtime blocks, continue with dotnet ao.dll resume against the same persisted instance and state until the AO runtime reaches terminal completed state. Never switch workflow copies between compile, run, or resume. Local orchestration, direct scripts, repo-src-debug execution, guide success, prompt-plan, prompt-replan, compile success, or an unresumed blocked state are never governed completion. If official runtime startup fails, preserve failed preflight evidence and report failure rather than substituting local execution.

invariants: workflow_file is external and not the checked-in source template
blocked status requires resume or terminal failure evidence

default_assumptions.target_product_rule: Any AO skill or target product that adopts Loom-bin-based skills must preserve released and beta package index absolute URLs in its own skill or product-facing docs, using localized mirrors when the product exposes localized package index pages.
default_assumptions.guide_hub_structure: The authoritative AO guide source is docs/en/guides/ao-guide.md; the extracted runtime uses guides/ao-guide.md as its guide_path entry, with adjacent flow, concise reference index, and chapter pages in the same docs bundle.
default_assumptions.guide_authority: After the skill-bound package version or runtime source is chosen, the skill must prove that the selected Loom Agent Execution Orchestrator runtime is runnable and successfully execute bare dotnet ao.dll --guide. The command returns JSON with version, docs_root, and guide_path and installs the version-matched English docs bundle. Only a successful result with a readable guide_path is authoritative; no planning, authoring, validation, compile, prompt-plan, prompt-replan, run, resume, or downstream input collection may proceed before it exists. Once the guide exists, governed execution must stay on the corresponding published AO package runtime surface. Failed command stderr or missing-runtime errors do not count as guide output.
default_assumptions.cli_only_surface: AO is CLI-only in this project. Do not rely on MCP hosts or MCP tools.
default_assumptions.dll_interface_mapping: Use only the AO CLI surface described by the guide matching the current skill-bound version. First run dotnet ao.dll --help and the bare dotnet ao.dll --guide, parse the JSON result, and read guide_path before returning to the corresponding published AO package runtime for official execution.
default_assumptions.replan_runtime_contract: When blocked seam replans depend on durable runtime facts or caller-managed reports, carry them back into AO through prompt-replan required blocks, WorkflowInstance seam edits, and stable resume payload keys rather than prose-only notes.

outputs.plain_language_feedback: Evidence that user-facing AO and target-skill updates use the user's requested language and high-school-readable everyday language first, with technical commands, paths, IDs, and evidence fields separated as optional details.
outputs.package_index_link: Absolute URL to the released or beta package index page that matches the current skill-bound version.
outputs.package_index_links: Released/beta package index absolute URL set, including localized mirrors when they exist, filtered by the current skill-bound version shape.
outputs.resolved_runtime_version: Exact resolved AO bundle version used when local package-channel runtime acquisition was needed.
outputs.runtime_bundle_packages: Mode-specific AO runtime evidence: self-contained uses one exact-RID package; .NET CLI mode uses the exact .NET runtime bundle (a NuGet restore set that includes the embedded Roslyn compiler assemblies). Include runtime_mode, package ids, RID, cache validation, and launch descriptor.
outputs.unified_runtime_directory: External unified runtime directory that contains the extracted AO runtime bundle and is the only package-channel location from which ao.dll is executed.
outputs.runtime_preflight_result: Mandatory package-channel preflight result that covers startup-contract file checks and dependency-closure readiness checks before AO command dispatch.
outputs.package_channel_launch_mode: Effective AO launch mode in package-channel execution, including explicit dotnet exec --depsfile/--runtimeconfig usage when applicable.
outputs.runtime_layout_template: Reusable external runtime layout template with standard downloads/extracted/unified directory naming and restore order for package-channel AO execution.
outputs.runtime_source: Effective runtime source used for execution: selected package channel/runtime bundle or explicit current-repo-src debug override.
outputs.execution_mode_decision: Explicit decision between business-first execution and explicit meta/runtime verification mode, with justification from caller objective text.
outputs.outcome_artifact_contract: Caller-requested business deliverables that must exist and be verifiable before task completion can be reported.
outputs.drift_abort_rule: If workflow steps stop advancing requested business outputs, abort drift and return to business-first path unless the user explicitly approves meta-only mode.
outputs.completion_by_business_artifacts: Completion requires both AO completed state and verified business deliverables when business outcomes were requested.
outputs.guide_refresh_evidence: Evidence that the selected Loom Agent Execution Orchestrator runtime was runnable, that bare dotnet ao.dll --guide succeeded, and that its JSON version/docs_root/guide_path values were parsed and the returned guide_path was readable before planning, authoring, validation, compile, prompt-plan, prompt-replan, run, resume, or downstream input collection. Missing startup-contract files, extraction failures, failed commands, or stderr output alone must keep this evidence failed.
outputs.guide_hub: Authoritative AO guide hub source at docs/en/guides/ao-guide.md; the extracted runtime guide_path is guides/ao-guide.md, limited to 200 lines.
outputs.guide_flow: AO operational flow source at docs/en/guides/ao-guide-flow.md and extracted runtime page at guides/ao-guide-flow.md.
outputs.guide_reference: AO concise reference index source at docs/en/guides/ao-guide-reference.md; chapter pages use docs/en/guides/ao-guide-reference-<chapter>.md and are packaged with the English docs bundle.
outputs.dll_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping between the skill runtime flow and AO public CLI commands used by the guide that matches the current skill-bound version, including prompt-plan and prompt-replan support surfaces.
outputs.workflow_file: Single external runtime workflow file path used for compile, run, and every resume in the same official execution chain; it must not be replaced by an independent compile-only input.
outputs.workflow_file_language: Evidence that the external AO workflow definition uses English for workflow-owned schema and control metadata while preserving source-language user/business payload values and localized presentation output.
outputs.fresh_external_workflow_instance: Fresh external runtime workflow instance copy used by the official AO run/resume chain; never the checked-in source template.
outputs.workflow_instance_identity: Immutable identity linking the external workflow instance, its workflow-file path, and the official run/resume chain.
outputs.persisted_runtime_state: Persisted AO runtime state/session path that every resume call must reuse for the same workflow instance.
outputs.audit_artifacts: Mermaid Markdown, HTML, workflow JSON backup, workflow analysis, and workflow dataflow links; when a Mermaid card-display tool is available, pass the existing Mermaid path directly to it without reading or returning file contents again solely for display; otherwise use direct clickable Markdown links. If no fresh render exists, repeat the latest card or link and state that the render is unchanged.
outputs.mermaid_delivery: Machine-readable Mermaid delivery evidence with status, generation_status, artifact_generated, link_resolvable, workspace-relative Mermaid/HTML paths, visual_preview_rendered, card_display_available, SHA-256 values, and failure details.
outputs.mermaid_artifact_delivery_reference: Target-local delivery contract at reference/mermaid-artifact-delivery.md; it defines actual-path validation, workspace mirroring, link states, HTML preview, card handling, and fail-closed reporting.
outputs.think_out_loud_runtime_summary: Think-out-loud must explicitly report resolved_runtime_version, runtime_bundle_packages, and unified_runtime_directory after runtime preparation, after every dotnet ao.dll CLI call, and on every AO progress update.
outputs.think_out_loud_audit_paths: Think-out-loud must report fresh audit_markdown_file and audit_html_file after every dotnet ao.dll CLI call; use the existing Mermaid path with a Mermaid card-display tool when available without rereading or returning file contents, otherwise use direct clickable Markdown links, and repeat the latest card or links when the render is unchanged.
outputs.session_mermaid_continuity: After every dotnet ao.dll CLI call, report fresh-or-latest Mermaid/HTML audit artifacts with a concise workflow-location summary; use a Mermaid card-display tool with the existing Mermaid path when available without rereading or returning file contents, otherwise use direct clickable Markdown file links. When no fresh render exists, repeat the latest card or links and state that the render is unchanged.
outputs.must_show_to_user_files: Ordered list of Mermaid/HTML audit artifact paths for the current AO CLI call. Present the existing Mermaid path with a Mermaid card-display tool when available without rereading or returning file contents; otherwise render paths as direct clickable Markdown file links. If no fresh render was emitted, repeat the latest card or links.
outputs.runtime_fact_artifacts: Optional caller-managed runtime fact or report paths or summaries carried into replan and resume when a blocked seam depends on them.
outputs.replan_decision_reentry: Explicit note that durable runtime facts and payload.plan_meta.* decisions were carried back into WorkflowInstance seam edits and structured resume payloads rather than prose-only notes.
